name: job-map-express
title_zh: 先问清客户再画步骤的 JTBD 任务地图生成器
tagline_zh: 在聊天里把客户要完成的‘任务’拆成步骤地图，缺信息先追问不瞎编；默认不按阶段一步走，逼你先把每个动作问透。
tagline_en: Turn customer jobs into step-by-step maps in chat. It asks for missing inputs first, never invents; no.
desc_en: Job Map Express — build JTBD job maps in chat. Use when the user mentions Job Map Express / JME or runs /job-map-express. Ask for missing inputs before inventing; never one step per phase by default.
why_zh: 它不急着出图，先逼你把客户目标、动作、场景问清楚，再逐层拆解；默认不按阶段一步走，避免你拍脑袋。
why_en: It refuses to sketch until goals, actions, and context are clear; no lazy phase-by-phase default, so every step is earned by.
limit_zh: 只认 JTBD 任务地图一种格式，不产出其他图表；需要你先提供客户与目标，否则它只会反复提问；地图以文本形式输出。
limit_en: Only JTBD job maps; needs your customer & goal or it just asks; outputs text, no visual files.
title_en: JTBD job map builder that asks before drawing steps
